response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT cs.constructorId, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM constructorStandings cs GROUP BY cs.constructorId), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM c) SELECT c.constructorId, k.nationality, c.cnt AS standings_count, c.cnt - a.avg_cnt AS diff_from_avg FROM c JOIN a LEFT JOIN constructors k ON k.constructorId = c.constructorId ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10
